newsitem.title: JAPAN: Debts at big Japan contractors total 9 trln yen.
newsitem.headline: Debts at big Japan contractors total 9 trln yen.

text.p: The amount of debts held by 53 major Japanese general contractors on which they must pay interest was roughly nine trillion yen at the end of March last year, Construction Minister Shizuka Kamei said on Friday.
He also said that debts guaranteed by the 53 firms totalled roughly three trillion yen while unrecovered loans were roughly one trillion yen at the end of March last year.
"However, not all of these are bad loans," he told a parliamentary budget committee.
